items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The name 'Alvin' is mentioned by the interviewer in a fragmented sentence ('Alvin used to play, I guess....') but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond to or acknowledge this mention in the provided text.

ctx.x: Well as far as the music is concerned, I've always said there is some good rock and there's some bad rock. The same way when the swing or the be-bop era was in, there was some good be-bop and there was some bad and that goes the same way with the music. Now as far as these drummers are concerned, there's Elvin Jones has got a very nice name, he happens to be one of the good ones. Some drummers that try to play like Elvin is very bad, they sound bad. And I would say that it runs in cycles like that. If you're…
Alvin used to play, I guess....
